description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of training iterations for six model variants listed in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. A purple solid line labeled “Vanilla” drops steeply from about 3.4 near 0 iterations to roughly 2.7 by around 20,000 iterations, then declines gradually to about 2.48 by 140,000. A blue solid line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” starts near 3.4, falls to about 2.85 around 20,000, and then decreases slowly to about 2.61 at 140,000. An orange solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” begins near 3.4, drops to roughly 2.75 by about 20,000, and then trends downward to about 2.52 by 140,000. A green solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” starts near 3.4, falls to around 2.74 near 20,000, and then gradually decreases to about 2.51 at 140,000. A red solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” begins near 3.4, drops to approximately 2.72 by about 20,000, and then declines to around 2.50 by 140,000. A darker blue solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” starts near 3.4, falls to about 2.70 around 20,000, and then decreases gradually to roughly 2.49 by 140,000.
